Generated by `tools/build-cases.js` from the same translation file the site
renders, so this index cannot fall behind the pages it lists. The site itself
is written in 12 languages: every page takes `?lang=` with one of
`en, ar, ku, tr, fr, es, de, ru, zh, ja, ko, hi`; ar and ku read right-to-left.

## Services

- Full Stack Web Development: Business websites, dashboards and internal tools — built responsive, fast, and shaped around how you actually work.
- Mobile Apps — Flutter: One Flutter codebase shipped to both iOS and Android, with clean UI and store-ready builds.
- IT Infrastructure & Networking: Servers, cabling, CCTV and network design for offices — CCNA-level diagnosis and MikroTik configuration.
- Linux & Windows Server Admin: Install, configure and keep servers running — file sharing, backups, users and hardening for small teams.
- Graphic & Brand Design: Logos, social creatives and promo material that look consistent everywhere your customers see you.
- Social Media & Ads Management: Run the pages, plan the content, and spend the ad budget where it brings customers through the door.

## How a job runs

- Brief (what & why): You describe the problem in your own words. I repeat it back, add what you left out, and we agree the target before anything is priced.
- Plan & quote (scope, cost, dates): A written scope: pages or screens, features, what is excluded, one fixed price and real dates. The number in this document is the number on the invoice.
- Build (weekly preview link): Work happens in the open — a preview link you can click every week, built from the Arabic layout first rather than translated from English afterwards.
- Deliver (handover, not a black box): Deployed, tested on real devices, handed over with the accounts, keys and a short written guide. You own the repository, the domain, the hosting.
- Support (the desk stays open): The same desk that answered during the build answers after it — server faults, printer queues, camera records and the next feature.
- Every stage is one message away — ask at any point and you get the answer the sheet already shows.

## Pricing

Every project gets a fixed written quote before work starts — no hourly surprises. These are honest starting points; the final price depends on scope.

- Business Website — $350: 5–7 pages, Arabic + English, contact form, fast hosting, delivered in ~2 weeks.
- Platform / E-commerce — $1100: Accounts, payments, admin dashboards, full RTL — built like Mukallaf or Bookly.
- Mobile App (Flutter) — $850: iOS + Android from one codebase, clean UI, store submission included.
- Server & IT Setup — $200: Windows/Linux servers, office network, CCTV — installed, secured and documented.
- Social Media Management — $120/mo: Monthly content plan, designs, posting and Meta ads management for your pages.
- Logo & Brand Design — $175: Logo, color system and ready-to-use templates for print and social.
- Domain & Hosting — $60: Domain purchase, DNS, business email addresses and first-year hosting setup.
- Custom / ERP — $2500: Custom software and ERP modules — scoped and quoted after a short call.

## Questions answered on the page

- What exactly do you build? Full stack websites and dashboards, Flutter apps for iOS and Android, network and server infrastructure, and the brand design around them — usually all four for the same client.
- Do you work in Arabic and English? Yes. Every product I ship is designed in both — Arabic with full right-to-left support, English for international audiences.
- How do projects start? Send a message or book a call. We talk about the problem, I send scope, price and timeline, and work starts once you approve. No surprise costs.
- How long does a project take? A business site: 1–2 weeks. A full platform or app: 4–10 weeks depending on modules. Infrastructure and support work is scheduled around your hours.
- Do you maintain what you build? Yes — updates, monitoring, backups and fixes after launch, as a monthly retainer or per request.
- Where are you based? Baghdad, Iraq (UTC+3). I work remotely with clients anywhere and handle on-site work across Baghdad.
- Does this site use cookies or analytics? No cookie is set here and no analytics vendor is in the path. The counter keeps one salted hash of an ip address per Baghdad day, so the same visit cannot count twice, and nothing that names anybody — the privacy page lists every piece of it.
- Which languages can a product ship in? Arabic and English as standard, both with the full layout in their own direction. This site itself is written in twelve languages from one translation file, so adding yours to a product is an edit, not a rebuild.
- What do you need from me to begin? What exists and what hurts: the pages, screens or systems involved, any logo and text you already have, and who approves the work. That is enough for a written scope, price and dates — and the work starts when you say so.
- Do I see the work while it is still being built? Yes: a preview link every week rather than a reveal at the end. Every stage is one message away, and the answers are on this sheet before you have to ask.
